name: Workflow automation
summary: n8n, Make and Zapier workflows that move data between your tools so your team stops copying and pasting.
answer: Workflow automation means connecting the apps your business already uses so data moves between them on its own. HTH builds automations in n8n, Make and Zapier, backed by Airtable or Supabase where you need a proper database. It's for teams who spend hours a week copying information between forms, CRMs, spreadsheets, invoicing and chat.
whoFor: Teams re-typing the same data into three different tools
Operations that depend on one person remembering to do things
Businesses with a Zapier bill that keeps growing and breaking
Agencies that need reliable automations they can resell

problem.heading: Your tools work. They just don't talk to each other.
problem.body: A form submission becomes an email, which someone copies into a spreadsheet, which someone else copies into the CRM, then the invoicing tool. Every hand-off is a delay and a chance for a mistake, and when the person who set it up leaves, nobody knows how it works.

deliverables.title: Process map
deliverables.detail: A diagram of what happens today and what will happen automatically, agreed before we build.

deliverables.title: Automations
deliverables.detail: Workflows in n8n, Make or Zapier, built with error handling and alerts when something fails.

deliverables.title: Data layer
deliverables.detail: Airtable or Supabase tables where a spreadsheet is no longer enough.

deliverables.title: Integrations
deliverables.detail: API connections to tools without a ready-made connector, including webhooks and custom endpoints.

deliverables.title: Documentation
deliverables.detail: Every workflow named, commented and documented so your team or ours can maintain it.

process.title: Map
process.detail: We list the repetitive tasks, how often they happen and what they cost in time.

process.title: Prioritise
process.detail: We start with the automations that save the most hours or remove the most risk.

process.title: Build and test
process.detail: Each workflow is built, tested with real data and monitored for a week before sign-off.

process.title: Document
process.detail: You get a written register of every automation, what triggers it and who to call.

timeline: 1 to 2 weeks for a first set of automations, then ongoing as needed.

faqs.question: n8n, Make or Zapier: which is best?
faqs.answer: Zapier is quickest for simple two-step automations. Make handles more complex logic at lower cost. n8n can be self-hosted, which is cheapest at volume and keeps data on your own server. We pick per workflow.

faqs.question: What happens when an automation breaks?
faqs.answer: Every workflow we build has error alerts. On a monthly plan we fix failures, usually the same day.

faqs.question: Can you take over automations someone else built?
faqs.answer: Yes. We audit them first, document what exists and fix or rebuild the fragile ones.
